label: Issue 1737 same-source contingent creation, omission, and selection adequacy
summary: Unregistered Lean finite controls in Results.Modal.OptimalCreationChoice.Solution on the existing OptimalCreationChoice/SelectedEffectBridge profiles. Reused, not new: a necessary source with varying or absent activity (NecessaryContingentActivity.necessaryWithContingentActivity #435, NecessaryVariableEffects.necessarySourceVariableEffects #462) and the creation/omission profiles SimplicityCollapse.optionalAct and inefficaciousAct (#555 Core). New: threeWorldCreationChecks (one rigid necessary source, two contingent created effects and an omission world; a selection table read from the world label tracks outputs at all worlds while a fixed actual-matching tag fails), threeWorldOptimalOutputs, and the optimality layer soleCreatedUnique, optionalOmissionOptimal, universalOmissionOutputOptimal, universalOmissionNotTotal, omissionChoiceChecks: a unique created optimum plus optimality of every actual output does not yield StableActOutput without positive-output totality; whether a create-or-refrain rationality principle supplies totality is open. omissionStructureChecks composes failed stability of inefficaciousAct from #555 Core. beingCarriesActApplication: under #555's BeingCarriesAct reading only the always-performed profile survives, where creating versus omitting is carried by the world label alone (the inefficacious, extrinsic branch, structurally the brute-selection rival). The controls model no intellect, will or option recognition (constant labels from the first draft were removed as content-free), and each created effect is its own world label, so selected effect and selected world coincide as a surrogate. Rejected shortcuts: capacity-to-exercise, best-created-to-must-create, matching-table-to-intention, fixed-act-to-fixed-effect. Note: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#same-source-knowledgechoicecreation-integration-1737-2026-11-23. CI passed on d23a5d3; independent semantic challenge findings (overstated prose, unacknowledged #435/#462/#555 reuse) repaired in PR-1875. The #1955 continuation distinguishes created benefit, fidelity of execution, complete decision value and intrinsic perfection of the same source. Some strict effect difference, strict reflection from effect to decision and from decision to intrinsic perfection, and invariant intrinsic perfection cannot all hold. The printer’s undertaking and its release identify a reason to choose one recipient’s smaller gift under explicit competing uses. A recipient’s claim in this case presupposes their existence. A greater aggregate return, a perfectly executed end or an absence of violated claims each leaves the overall choice ranking open. See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#effect-superiority-practical-excellence-and-intrinsic-source-perfection-1955-2026-11-24. With the goodness issue’s four complete decisions, due care for actual recipients admits O (omission), A (one cared for), and B (two cared for), and excludes C (one deprived). Adding maximization over the eligible decisions selects B. Holding the ranking fixed under independent normative truths or divine-nature goodness isolates the extra normative bridge. Access without theology and independence from decree each leave ontic grounding open. Goodness at esse still requires a substantive bridge to the moral goodness of this choice.
blocker: Philosophically OPEN: same-source intrinsic intentional cognitive/will content, complete reason-grounded specification compatible with simple necessary actuality (under BeingCarriesAct only the world-label-carried branch survives), a create-or-refrain rationality principle supplying positive-output totality, intentional causal/esse efficacy, knowledge of actual contingent contents, and comparison with a fully articulated impersonal necessary-source alternative and brute selection under the same complete-world explanandum. No new registered result, frozen Challenge, Comparator config, binding, GOD_4 edge, claim or root-premise discharge. For #1955, supply a recipient-specific reason applicable to the proposed origination, justify permission or dominance across complete alternatives including omission, and identify that reason as operative in this giving. An impersonal policy can select the same end. An assessment of the producer that includes its actual decisions can vary even when its intrinsic nature is held fixed.

current_assessment.scope: #1955 complete decisions, due care and intrinsic source perfection
current_assessment.assessment: A better created outcome gives a separate question about the fidelity of execution, the complete choice and the intrinsic state of the same producer. An undertaking can give a reason to choose a smaller gift. Due care for every actual beneficiary admits omission and both fully cared-for outcomes. Maximizing created benefit among them selects the larger. Either proposed ground of goodness needs the additional value-to-obligation bridge.
current_assessment.next_test: Identify a recipient-specific reason for the proposed origination, justify permission or dominance across all complete alternatives, and trace the actual choice to the same giver’s apprehension of that reason.

The focused recheck at af1484b79 accepted the two reflection scopes and the complete goodness follow-up. The independent delivery changes only a navigation reference in the reviewed section. PR-1956.
